question: Does body-twin canonicalisation + clustering collapse the truth signal and boost the truth cluster's rank among s057g candidates?
hypothesis: Truth and its body-twin collapse to one canonical (q, omega), so cluster sum-score boosts the truth cluster's rank above its raw 90th-percentile.
narrative_md: Canonicalising the 548 s057g candidates collapses them to 325 clusters but does NOT boost the truth cluster -- it ranks 107/325 (33rd %ile, WORSE than raw 90th %ile). The top clusters at qa_d_canon ~175deg are NOT body-twins of truth; they are genuinely different multi-solution (q_a, omega) alternates (sum-score 800-930 vs truth 178) that pass forward-prop validation. Multi-solution structure dominates seed 89. Reads truth cluster rank -- oracle-leak, N=1.
